qualification_provenance: Retained local 2026-11-22 emulated campaign, made while the oxfuzz kernel command was being developed. It ran on an uncommitted working tree on top of commit ffe2cfef, for which no patch digest was taken, with an earlier local build of the 0.2.3 sandbox image. It was not rerun on the candidate commit. The campaign was started through the service operation that oxfuzz kernel and the desktop app call (ServiceContainer::run_syzkaller_observed_with_environment), driven by the live test live_syzkaller_boots_executes_programs_and_records_the_campaign; the oxfuzz kernel command line itself was not run end to end. The full record, with the failed attempts, is docs/acceptance/kernel-emulated-2026-11-22.md at the tag.
guest: Debian bookworm arm64, QEMU TCG on macOS arm64; rootfs sha256 7c6874d3a115cf6995cec7ca606b3f283bf5006c8280fb52b0f44008552d2eb2
termination: completed; timeout wrapper exit 124 is expected
retention: corpus.db retained under the run's output directory inside the test's temporary workspace root.
approval: None requested: the test constructs the service without an approval handler. An operator run goes through the oxfuzz kernel approval.
limitations: Not rerun on the candidate commit, and the tested tree is not identified by a digest.
Not Linux/KVM performance qualification; about one program per second under emulation.
No kernel crash occurred; kernel crash reproduction and complete symbolization are not qualified.
Kernel/rootfs/private guest keys are not distributed with the application or website.
The oxfuzz kernel command line, a supplied manager.cfg, the desktop app's launch path, Stop and resume, amd64 guests and more than one guest were not exercised.
A campaign that ends before the first corpus entry is recorded as Done with zero coverage; the command line says that such a run tested nothing, and the service record does not distinguish it.
candidate_delta: Not established as a file list: the campaign ran before the feature branch was committed and merged. The candidate contains that work together with everything merged after it.
